summary: Tests require slice placeholder expansion to declared ID; lifecycle command descriptors must be shell-free; existing run directories are rejected before context consumption; legacy regression requires a hash-bound failed prior RED and rejects passing/unbound predecessors; legacy regression must pass current GREEN while normal RED requires failure; successor binding requires matching failed RED command and rejects wrong/passing predecessor; lifecycle outer timeout sums registered preparation/refactor/red/green/terminal command timeouts (expected 270s).
